title: Jesus stills the storm
author: Hajime Murai
note: 2022 downloadable source snapshot. Relationship labels are source data; explanation wording is ChiFold editorial. Source Bible quotations are excluded. Subverse elements show whole verses as context.

nodes.label: B
nodes.title:
A reaction of the people against Jesus.
In this structure, contrast of storm and calm is arranged with fear of disciples and surprise of people. The miracle changed mind of people and lead to the question who Jesus is. This question continues in next pericope
